os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    marker = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 3)]
    color = grid[marker[0][0]][marker[0][1]]
    points = [(r, c) for r, c in marker if grid[r][c] == color]
    minr, minc = min(r for r,c in points), min(c for r,c in points)
    points = [(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in points]
    shapes = set()
    for turns in range(4):
        q = []
        for y,x in points:
            for _ in range(turns): y,x = x,-y
            q.append((y,x))
        for reflect in (False, True):
            z = [(y,-x) if reflect else (y,x) for y,x in q]
            a,b = min(y for y,x in z), min(x for y,x in z)
            shapes.add(tuple(sorted((y-a,x-b) for y,x in z)))
    h,w = len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for shape in shapes:
        sh,sw = max(y for y,x in shape)+1,max(x for y,x in shape)+1
        for r in range(h-sh+1):
            for c in range(w-sw+1):
                cells = [(r+y,c+x) for y,x in shape]
                if all(grid[y][x] == 0 for y,x in cells):
                    for y,x in cells: out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)
print(p)
